owner_statement: P0/P1禁训门是啥；不读holdout、不promote、不部署没必要，都可以做。

scope.applies_to: the current Grade-A 8000 positive plus 24000 matched-negative YOLO11s imgsz=960 experiment and its resulting weights
scope.model_input_contract_unchanged: completed-history windows contain 2-9 post-core confirmation bars

execution_policy.holdout: freeze the evaluation contract first, consume once, record the configuration-specific consumption number, and do not tune on that result
execution_policy.promotion_and_deployment: authorization removes the owner-approval blocker; eligibility still depends on measured results and deployment input-contract parity
execution_policy.trading: deployment authorization does not authorize placing, cancelling, or resizing real-money orders
